blind.table_distance_name: straight wattle and daub wall section
blind.description: A freestanding section of modular wattle-and-daub wall, framed horizontally by dark brown wooden beams at the top and bottom. The central infill is textured tan/cream plaster or daub with visible cracking and grime near the ground. Two damaged areas on the plaster expose the underlying woven wood wattle lattice inside. The geometry is solid and clean with stylized, slightly softened edges, standing directly on its lower timber beam.
blind.from_above: A narrow dark brown rectangular wooden beam running horizontally with slightly rounded corners and subtle organic waviness.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 7.5 to 8 feet tall (noticeably taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure) and roughly 4.5 to 5 feet wide.
